messages.text: Are you planning on getting the hammer miner dc02's in stock again?
Read the hammer miner scrypt dogecoin litecoin page
Searched the catalog · Hammer Miner DC02

Right now the DC02 is split by plug. The EU-plug version is in stock at $239.99. The US-plug version is sold out, and I don't have a confirmed restock date for it. I won't guess at one.

Which plug do you need? If it's EU, you can order today, but note it's sold as final sale. If it's US, I'll ask the team whether more are coming and when. Our other Scrypt Hammers, the DC04 and DC06, are out of stock too.
Im in the us, but i am going to hook it up to a meanwell power supply, so it doesn't matter which plug it comes with, as long as the board itself is wired the same. What is the cost on that unit?
Handed to the team · No US restock date in the catalog. EU stock is in the Netherlands warehouse, and

The DC02 is $239.99, the same for both plugs, and it's sold as final sale.

The problem is where it ships from, not the plug. The EU units are in our Netherlands warehouse, and we normally don't ship from there to US addresses. The listing says it comes with a 12V 5A power supply, so your Meanwell should do the same job. Still, I can't confirm the board is identical on both versions.

I've asked the team two things: when the US version is back in stock, and whether we can send you an EU unit. They're offline right now and pick it up today at 10am ET. Their answer will come to (email hidden)
Before you go, one thing: are you powering just the one DC02 from that Meanwell, or running several miners off it?
This miner will be the 3rd one, as i have 1 dc02 and a bitaxe 701 hex as well.
Nice setup. What's pulling you toward a second DC02 instead of another Bitcoin miner like the Hex?
I would like to get some more scrypt hashing power, and i have room for another dc02. The hex is challenging to cool, so another one of them would not be my first choice.

That makes sense, thanks for explaining. A second DC02 adds Scrypt hashrate without the heat you're dealing with on the Hex. The team will email you at (email hidden) about whether we can get you one.
